desc.T1: Intention-to-treat analyzes every randomized patient; excluding dropouts makes it a per-protocol analysis, not ITT.
desc.T2: A non-significant superiority test does not show equivalence; equivalence needs a prespecified margin and an equivalence or non-inferiority test.
desc.T3: Averaging follow-up of deaths while excluding censored patients is biased; median survival needs a Kaplan-Meier estimate that uses censored data.
desc.T4: Assigning by odd and even days is alternation, not randomization: allocation is predictable and cannot be concealed.
